records.scope: Flask application implementing the ups.com mirror: the brown-header home page with the tracking widget and quick tools, multi-number tracking with per-shipment status cards, tracking detail with milestone progress bar, activity feed, shipment facts, delivery-change flows (hold at UPS Access Point with locator-backed location choice, reroute with the $18.00 Delivery Intercept fee, reschedule), the Create-a-Shipment guest wizard with live service pricing, the Calculate Time and Cost estimator backed by the captured quote matrix, the Schedule-a-Pickup wizard with On-Call Pickup fees ($15.75 same-day / $9.65 future-day / $16.60 Saturday incl. the $6.95 stop charge), the UPS Location Finder with type filters and location detail pages (hours, latest air/ground drop-off), services hub with side-by-side comparison, business solutions and The UPS Store pages, the guest/signed-in claims wizard with status timeline, the Help and Support Center with scored article search, auth (log in / sign up), the account dashboard and the /_health probe.

Deterministic build-time and boot-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data/ snapshots; every seed function early-returns on a populated DB, dates are pinned to the 2026-09-28 snapshot and the benchmark password hash is frozen so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build.

The eight domestic services (1DM, 1DA, 1DP, 2DM, 2DA, 3DS, GND, GSP) with their delivery commitments, guarantee flags, transit days, size limits, Saturday-delivery availability, latest-pickup and schedule-by times, captured from the UPS Retail Rate and Service Guide (effective 2026-09-07) and the live Calculate Time and Cost wizard results.

230 retail service quotes captured from the live wwwapps.ups.com/ctc Calculate Time and Cost wizard on 2026-09-28: eight origin/destination markets (New York-Chicago, New York-San Francisco, Chicago-Atlanta, San Francisco-Seattle, Miami-New York, Austin-Cincinnati, Denver-Chicago, Boston-Philadelphia) at 1/5/15/40 lbs, one residential-destination variant, each with price, transit days, delivered-by commitment, guaranteed flag, latest pickup time, schedule-by time, billable weight and the per-service breakdown (transportation charge, Delivery Area Surcharge, Fuel Surcharge).

240 UPS locations returned by the UPS Location Finder XML API (widgets.ups.com/api/ups.app/xml/Locator, the service behind the ups.com header locator) for twelve ZIP searches on 2026-09-28: The UPS Store, UPS Access Point, UPS Drop Box, UPS Customer Center, Authorized Shipping Outlet and retail-chain locations with real names, street addresses, phones, geocodes, operating hours, latest air/ground drop-off times, comments and service offerings. Search geocodes came from the upstream /dropoff/api/maps/geocode endpoint; displayed distances are haversine miles between captured geocodes.

Tracking application UI strings and error copy from webapis.ups.com/track/api/WemsData/GetLookupData (captured 2026-09-28) plus the status explanations from the ups.com Understanding Tracking Status support article (Label Created, Shipped/On the Way, Out for Delivery, Transferred to Post Office, Delivered, Delivered to a UPS Access Point, Exception).

Value-added service fees from the UPS Retail Rate and Service Guide (effective 2026-09-07) and the demand surcharge guide: pickup options (Smart Pickup $18.50/wk, Daily Pickup $39.00/wk, Day-Specific Pickup $8.00/$15.75/$23.25/$30.50/wk, Daily On-Route $11.25/wk, On-Call $9.65 future-day / $15.75 same-day), Saturday services ($12.00/$8.00/$6.95 stop charges), delivery options (Signature Required $7.70/pkg, Adult Signature $9.35/pkg, Hold at Location and Ship to Access Point at no charge), Declared Value for Carriage tiers ($5.10 for $100.01-$300; $1.70 per $100 above $300, guide example $950 -> $17.00) and UPS Delivery Intercept ($18.00 web / $21.00 phone).

Benchmark fixtures authored from the captured material: four personas with addresses, fourteen shipments with 18-character 1Z tracking numbers (real format: shipper + service code + serial + mod-10 check digit), activity scans using the real UPS scan vocabulary at real UPS hub cities, delivered/in-transit/exception/label-created/Access-Point-held/Ground-Saver-to-USPS states, a three-package shipment with per-package scans, and the live Middle East Service Impacts service alert. Dates are pinned relative to the 2026-09-28 snapshot Monday.

Eighteen support and content articles captured as rendered from ups.com: Understanding Tracking Status, UPS Delivery Notice, UPS Delivery Intercept, Where's My Package, How To Return a Package, Flat Rate Shipping (Simple Rate), UPS Ground Saver, Freight Quote, Manage Your UPS Profile, Shipping Guides and Resources, Shipping Tools, File a Claim, Shipping Costs and Rates Guides, Signature-Required Deliveries, How To Ship a Package, How To Void a Shipment, Change a Delivery and UPS My Choice.

Twenty-five content pages captured as rendered: pickup and drop-off options (overview, Daily, Smart, Day-Specific, Saturday), the UPS Access Point program page, business shipping tools, customer return services, UPS billing, Quantum View, UPS My Choice for Business, expand internationally, consulting services, customized logistics, international shipping, tariffs, order supplies, The UPS Store (overview, pack and ship, services, print, mailboxes), service alerts, how to ship, domestic shipping services and the guest claim wizard.
Per-file inventory (bytes, SHA-256, upstream source URL) for every managed image under static/images/; enforced by the image build's check_asset_inventory.py gate.

Real ups.com media: the UPS shield logo (webassets logo SVG), header icons (pin, alert, profile, social), and the AEM asset-library photography and banners served from assets.ups.com (hero, services, business, store, claims and support imagery) downloaded from their upstream URLs on 2026-09-28.

Hand-written stylesheet reproducing the captured ups.com design language (brown #351c15 header, gold #ffc400 CTA, UPS blue #0662bb links, gray #5f5753 secondary text, card layout, milestone progress bar, quote tables, fee tables, locator chips and footer).
Client behaviors: header mega-menu toggles, tracking textarea auto-grow, quote-table sort by cost/time, locator filter-chip zip sync.

Jinja templates reproducing the captured upstream surfaces: base chrome (header, quick tools, footer), home, tracking results, tracking detail with milestone bar and activity timeline, delivery change, Calculate Time and Cost, Create-a-Shipment wizard and confirmation, Schedule-a-Pickup wizard and confirmation, locator results and location detail, services hub/compare/detail, business solutions and content pages, The UPS Store pages, Help and Support Center with search, support articles with hero imagery, claims hub/wizard/status, alerts, auth pages and the account dashboard.

Pytest suite (43 tests): health contract, homepage content, tracking lookup (valid, invalid, not-found, multi-number), tracking detail facts, Access-Point hold card, exception meaning, delivery-change hold flow with DB persistence, blocked change after delivery, exact captured quote checks, residential surcharge, weight interpolation, CTC validation, ship wizard end-to-end with 1Z checksum verification, declared-value tiers, pickup fees (future/same-day/Saturday), locator counts and filters, location detail hours, claims wizard end-to-end and rejection, auth flows, register, service/compare/business/support content, seed idempotency, four benchmark users, tasks.jsonl contract (5 keys, 20 rows, port 40107, word bounds, no answer leakage) and exact image coverage.

Twenty goal-style benchmark tasks across tracking, delivery change, rate shopping, service comparison, shipment creation, pickup scheduling, locator research, claims, support articles, business fees and The UPS Store, each designed for a 15+ step honest browser solution.
Attribution and derivation notice for the captured ups.com material and the mirror-authored fixtures.
